name: govnavigator
description: GovNavigator Ghana - run the FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend from one terminal.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt && if not exist .env copy .env.example .env && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.scripts.seed --reset
scripts.setup:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && if not exist .env.local copy .env.local.example .env.local
